title: Predicting loss under unseen learning rate schedules
setting: A fixed language model, dataset distribution and AdamW configuration; vary continuous nonincreasing schedules after a fixed warmup.
inputs: A small declared calibration set and the target schedule, without future target-run loss or internal-state observations.
target: The entire held-out validation loss curve and its uncertainty.
intervention: Change schedule shape and duration at held-out learning rates.

relations.reason: Predictive state closure is one possible route, not a necessary component of every schedule law.

evidence.theory: Candidate-level summary only; precise assumptions not yet audited.
evidence.empirical: No repository reproduction; cited paper reports results in its own settings.
evidence.prediction: The precise proposed transfer test has not been conducted by this repository.
